The issuer shows very weak liquidity (current ratio of 0.34), increasing risk of near-term funding stress. Leverage also appears high given total liabilities far exceed equity, though operating profitability is moderate (EBIT of 5,851 on revenue of 31,795), which partially offsets balance-sheet risk. Overall, this supports a speculative-grade rating in the lower “BB” range.  

DECISION: BB-
